list_child.name: lst_rls
list_child.desc: Returns the complete roster of track releases currently tracked in the label's release calendar system. Use this when you need a full overview of every release regardless of its current production stage.

get_child.name: get_rls
get_child.desc: Retrieves a single release record identified by its unique release id. This is the appropriate call when you already know which specific release you need details on.

list_parent.name: lst_art
list_parent.desc: Returns the full list of artists currently signed to or associated with the label's roster. This includes every artist on file, independent of how many releases they currently have.

get_parent.name: get_art
get_parent.desc: Retrieves a single artist record identified by their unique artist id. Use this call when you already know exactly which artist you are looking up.

delete_child.name: rm_rls
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes a release record from the label's system, and this action cannot be undone once it has been executed. Use this only when a release entry was created in error or must be scrubbed entirely.

set_enum.name: set_rls_stg
set_enum.desc: Updates the production stage of a release to reflect where it currently sits in the pipeline, moving it between demo, mastering, scheduled, and released. This keeps the release calendar accurate for everyone downstream.

set_bool.name: flag_expl
set_bool.desc: Marks a release as containing explicit content so that storefronts and playlists can apply the correct content warning. This flag should be set any time a release contains explicit lyrics.

set_ref.name: mv_art
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a release from one artist to a different artist on the roster, which is useful when a release was logged under the wrong act. This updates the ownership record but leaves all other release details untouched.

send.name: notif_art
send.desc: Sends a direct notification to the artist associated with a release, which is typically used to alert them about a status change. This does not go through management and reaches the artist's own contact channel directly.
